A Roof before Nightfall

You bend the first poles into place while your companions gather around the promise of a dry night.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Knowledge

Time: One hour per crafting attempt.

Target / range / shape: A chosen campsite and available ordinary materials; one hour per attempt.

Build a temporary shelter for yourself and up to six companions. This card grants the reusable @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.5019b6b0e969af00.JournalEntryPage.28012fb87352faca]{Camp Shelter recipe}; use its target 4, materials, tools and one-hour attempt time. On completion it shelters the occupants from ordinary rain and wind; it is not fortification. No group crafting.

- Weak: 1 construction progress; identify any unsuitable material before consuming it. - Standard: 2 construction progress and the same material check. - Strong: 3 construction progress and the same material check; if this result completes the shelter, it can be packed for reuse as one Bulk 1 bundle under the recipe’s rules.

Duration: Until dismantled or damaged; packing requires ten minutes.

Equipment / acquisition: Craft tools, Bulk 1, if absent. The recipe is known on learning this card; no materials granted.

---

Tier / minimum level: 3 · DP: 4 · Requirements to learn: Wilderness 2 and Craft 1

Type: Skill / Crafting / Utility

Limits: This card crafts only its Camp Shelter recipe. Extreme weather and hostile attack can damage the shelter; DA states visible limitations before construction.

ID: a-roof-before-nightfall
